'''Longcat''' is a game which can be found in the [[Quest]]. It has 50 levels.

== Gameplay ==
This is a game that involves a cat, which moves on the same direction the player swipes their figner at, and the cat will keep moving towards that direction until it either hits a wall or hits itself, where in that case, will make the player lose. The goal of each level is to fill all of the gaps found in the levels.

== Trivia ==
*The name of the cat is Longcat.
